title: Aureline M5 local-CI parity strip
description: Canonical per-domain descriptor for a local-CI parity strip. Names the object class, its review-pack association, the analyzed base / head, the per-check parity state (provider-authoritative, local-parity-estimate, ci-only, not-evaluated-here, provider-unavailable, stale-relative-to-base/head), and whether the strip is stale relative to base / head — so a local parity estimate never masquerades as provider-authoritative mergeability. Downstream the local-CI parity strip, merge-readiness, review detail, provider handoff, and support / export packets point at this schema instead of restating parity by hand. Raw check outputs, secret values, and private endpoints never cross this boundary.
